search.api_version: Brave Web Search API, GET https://api.search.brave.com/res/v1/web/search (unversioned path; response date recorded per run)
search.notes: SEARCH_API_KEY holds the Brave subscription token.

fetch.implementation: httpx.Client(follow_redirects=True, timeout=30s) + stdlib html.parser text extraction

model.rationale: Current OpenAI flagship general model at a dated snapshot, so the run is reproducible. Not a mini or nano tier, so the baseline is not weakened; not a pro tier, which a team would not deploy for every query. The model rejects non-default temperature, so temperature is omitted (provider default 1).

cost_sources.search: Brave Search API plan pricing on the run date; count of search calls recorded per run
cost_sources.model: usage.prompt_tokens and usage.completion_tokens from each response, times OpenAI published rate for gpt-5.5 on the run date
